camdrones.crew.invite.received: %s invites you to operate the camera.
camdrones.crew.invite.accept.hover: Take over the camera of this drone
camdrones.crew.bound.operator: You now operate the camera. It keeps its direction when the pilot turns the drone. Right stick pans and tilts, left stick up and down zooms, action 2 points it forward again; hold action 4 to hand the camera back.
camdrones.crew.released.operator: The pilot took the camera back.
camdrones.crew.released.pilot: You took the camera back from %s.
camdrones.crew.waiting.pilot: Operator %s disconnected – the crew waits %s for them to return.
camdrones.crew.restored.operator: Crew restored: you control the camera again.
camdrones.crew.restored.pilot: %s is back and controls the camera again.
camdrones.crew.expired.pilot: %s did not return in time – the crew has ended.
camdrones.crew.blocked.operator: You are back, but you can't take over the camera yet: get within video range of the drone, into its dimension, and stop flying another drone. The crew waits %s more.
camdrones.crew.blocked.operator.overlay: Camera out of reach – the crew waits %s
camdrones.crew.blocked.pilot: %s is back but can't take over the camera yet – the crew waits %s more.
camdrones.crew.blocked.pilot.overlay: Operator back, camera out of reach – waiting %s
camdrones.crew.unreachable.operator: You could not take over the camera in time – the crew has ended.
camdrones.crew.unreachable.pilot: %s could not take over the camera in time – the crew has ended.
camdrones.crew.servo.volume.tooltip: Volume of the short servo sound at the drone when the gimbal recenters or an operator takes over the camera. Moving the gimbal stays silent like a real gimbal, 0 % turns the sound off.
camdrones.crew.screen.title: Crew – camera operator
camdrones.crew.screen.view_failed: No live view: out of video range or not allowed.
camdrones.crew.screen.hint: Invited players get a request in chat.
camdrones.crew.view.operator: The operator has the gimbal camera – you fly with the FPV camera
camdrones.crew.view.recording: Recording: pilot view on the gimbal camera until you stop
camdrones.crew.verdict.rule_off: Two-pilot camera is turned off in this world.
camdrones.crew.verdict.no_drone: No camera drone found. Fly it, hold its paired flight planner or stand next to it.
camdrones.crew.verdict.no_gimbal: This drone has no gimbal camera.
camdrones.crew.verdict.not_allowed: Only the pilot or the owner of the drone can do that.
camdrones.crew.verdict.too_far: %s is too far away (at most %s blocks).
camdrones.crew.verdict.taken: This camera already has an operator.
camdrones.crew.verdict.busy: %s is flying this drone or operates another camera.
camdrones.crew.verdict.refused: Propwash refused the camera binding (video range, already flying or not available yet).
camdrones.crew.verdict.not_operator: You do not operate a camera.
camdrones.crew.verdict.rate: Too many requests, please wait a moment.
camdrones.crew.solo.bound: The drone flies itself and you run the camera: without stick input the gimbal follows the flight plan, from your first move you are in control. Right stick pans and tilts, left stick up and down zooms, action 2 points it forward, action 1 pauses or resumes the mission, holding action 1 aborts it and lands; Esc or holding action 4 takes you back.
camdrones.crew.solo.ended: The flight without a pilot has ended – you are back in the normal view.
